name: trade-server-mcp
description: Trade on a YourBourse Trade Server from Claude — as a trader.

yb_base_url.title: Server address
yb_base_url.description: Your Trade Server's full web address, from your broker — include https:// and no trailing slash (e.g. https://your-server.example.com, sometimes with a port like :32236).

yb_login.title: Account login
yb_login.description: Your trading account login — digits only (a positive integer).

yb_password.title: Password
yb_password.description: Your account password. Stored securely in your operating system's keychain.

yb_broker.title: Broker name (optional)
yb_broker.description: Leave blank unless your broker told you to set it.
